summary: Collections are tested with ansible-test, shipped with Ansible 2.9+, so general testing docs apply, but collection authors running a stable release don't need the source-checkout path and environment setup steps.
questions: What tool do I use to test a collection?
Do I need to run Ansible from source to test my collection?

answer_card.title: Testing collections with ansible-test
answer_card.answer_md: Use `ansible-test` (included since Ansible 2.9.0). The general testing docs apply, but you **don't** need to run Ansible from source; installing a stable release sets up the binary paths and environment for you.
